_note: Row counts per table of the memory store at the snapshot 2026-10-06 12:00 CDT (cutoff t < 1791306000), read through a mode=ro connection from the frozen copy harness_20261006_1200.db that the SQLite online backup API took from harness/data/harness.db at 12:00:05 CDT. Each table is filtered by its own timestamp: events, harvest_attempts, chat, job_events, junctures, prices by t; walk_moves, guard_points, teleporters by first_t; knowledge and lumber_spots by created_t; sessions by started; episodes by t_end (a trip row exists once the trip ends); knowledge_vec by its knowledge row's created_t. harvest_nodes and meta have no timestamp column: counted in the frozen copy as it is (5 s after the cutoff). file_bytes is the size of that backup-API copy, which has the WAL's rows folded in and no -wal file (wal_bytes 0); the live store's own file and WAL size were not read. Schema v5 (meta.schema_version). FTS5 shadow tables (knowledge_fts_*) omitted. writer = main writer process (docs/MEMORY.md "Who writes what").
